$comment: Uncached task seconds per Nx task for the two `Affected (build-<n>)` lanes of ci.yml (build, size, check-desktop-payload, check-critical-budget, check-static-shells and check-server-output, and the tasks they depend on), which deal the affected projects with scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts --graph. Source: the 20 successful `Affected (build)` jobs over 400 s of 20 green merge-group runs of ci.yml, 2026-11-17 22:08Z to 2026-11-18 01:27Z, at --parallel=1; a task's seconds are the gap from the previous task header (or the step start) to its own in the job log, and each value is the median of its uncached samples. An unlisted task of a dealt project's own targets weighs defaultSeconds; an unlisted dependency weighs nothing. Refresh when a listed task's median moves by more than a quarter, when a project is split, or when this snapshot is older than 60 days.
